data_fields.name: maxPct
data_fields.donor_constant: highest-tech-level, percent; default 10000.0; 0 in data means no limit

best_idea: A music bed is chosen from a data list of progress windows keyed on one number, and when a track ends the next window that fits plays (silence when none fits).
decision_why: The window list suits zone beds keyed on progression, but Frankendom must feed progress from the one ledger and key beds to zone data; the donor's gate is inert as shipped (setTechLevel has no caller).
acceptance: A player's zone bed changes when ledger progression crosses a window bound, and a client test asserts that a window list with no fit returns silence in one pass.
